profile.ja: 抜け忍の対魔忍。五車学園を卒業後、対魔忍として活躍していたが、ある任務の途中で突如仲間を撒き脱走、ノマドに下る。ノマドの一員となったが、その出自からあまり快く思われず、朧やイングリッドからも睨まれ、常に誰かに監視されながら任務を行っている。対魔忍としては紙を操る能力を持っており、大量の紙を操ることで自身を色々な姿に変化、強化することができる。さらにノマドで強化改造をされ『触れることで敵を吸収し、その人物の知識、情報を得る』という魔族の能力を併用することができるようになった。しかし、対魔忍と魔族の力を併用すると身体が拒絶反応を起こして痙攣してしまうことも。
profile.en: She is a rogue Taimanin. After graduating from Gosha Academy, she was active as a Taimanin, but suddenly abandoned her comrades and defected to Nomad during a mission. She became a member of Nomad, but due to her background, she is not well-liked, and is often glared at by people like Kiri and Ingrid, always being monitored while on missions. As a Taimanin, she has the ability to manipulate paper, and by manipulating large amounts of paper, she can change and strengthen herself in various ways. Additionally, after being enhanced and modified by Nomad, she gained the ability to absorb enemies by touching them, allowing her to acquire their knowledge and information. However, when she uses both her Taimanin and demon powers, her body reacts with a rejection response, causing her to convulse.

text.ja: イスカよ――ノマドで改造されてからは、そう名乗ってるわ。元の名前なんて、聞く必要ないでしょう？
text.en: I'm Iska - that's what I've been calling myself since I was modified by Nomad. You don't need to know my old name, do you?

text.ja: 強化改造で得られたのは、相手を取り込む魔族の能力ね。知識や情報を得られるから、かなり有用な能力だったと思うわ。乱用は控えてるけどね
text.en: The ability I gained from the enhancement is the demon's power to absorb opponents. It's quite useful since I can gain knowledge and information from it. I'm being careful not to abuse it, though.

text.ja: 改造後の能力って、元からの力と併用すると、身体が拒絶反応を起こすのよ。だから、あんまり使いたくないわけ
text.en: The thing is, when I use my modified abilities together with my original powers, my body has a rejection response. That's why I don't want to use it too much.

text.ja: ……これ？　紙式よ、見たことない？　まぁ、私より……従妹のほうが、ずっとうまく使えるわ
text.en: ...This? It's a paper style - haven't you seen it before? Well, my cousin is actually much better at using it than I am.

text.ja: そろそろ戻らないと……幹部の連中に嫌われててね。ずーっと見張られてるのよ、嫌になっちゃうわ
text.en: I should get going soon... I'm not on good terms with the higher-ups, and I'm always being watched. It's getting on my nerves.

text.ja: 全部終わったら、全部話すわ……それまでは、ちゃんと――私のこと、最低の裏切り者だって思っておいてね
text.en: Once everything is over, I'll tell you everything... Until then, just think of me as the worst kind of traitor, okay?

text.ja: あの子、ちゃんとやってるかしら……人と関わるのが苦手な子だったから、ちょっと心配なのよね
text.en: I wonder if she's doing okay... She's not very good with people, so I'm a bit worried about her.

text.ja: ……これ？　手慰みってやつ……気がつくと、つい折り紙してるのよね
text.en: ...This? It's just a habit of mine, I guess... I often find myself folding paper without realizing it.

text.ja: ……ほんっと、最悪っ……わかってるわよ、言えばいいんでしょ！　わ、私の、オマンコ……また、可愛がってくださいっ……くっっ……
text.en: ...Honestly, this is the worst... I know I should just say it, but... my pussy... please, be gentle with me again... ugh...

text.ja: ふぅっ、ふっ、うぅ……ちょっと、話しかけないで……イキすぎて、つらいのっ……そのチンポ、よすぎるのよっ……んっ、はぁぁ……
text.en: Fuu... ha... uuu... just give me a minute... don't talk to me right now... I came too much, and it hurts... your dick is just too good... nnn, haah...
